reveal_fog_of_war: reveal fog of war on a top-down map from an agent's current position and viewing angle
draw_fog_of_war_line: draw a visibility line on a fog of war mask between two points stopping at walls
bresenham_supercover_line: compute all grid cells along a line between two points using the Bresenham supercover algorithm
build_fog_of_war_visualization: build a python module to reveal fog of war on a top-down map using agent position and field of view
test_reveal_fog_of_war: test the reveal_fog_of_war function with a sample top-down map and agent position
